job.question: A county pension fund is searching for a single manager of managers covering domestic equity, international equity and fixed income. What is the maximum mandate size, and what is the firm-level AUM limit for responders?
job.expected_facts: A mandate of up to $350 million; responders must have less than $30 billion in firm-level assets under management (Cook County Fund, RFP 25-0004).
job.acceptance: Accept up to $350m and firm AUM strictly below $30bn. Cook County identification is optional.

reviews.reason: This is a Teachers’ Retirement System of Illinois RFP for private equity investment consultant services, not the county fund’s manager-of-managers search. It states neither the requested maximum mandate size nor a firm-level AUM eligibility limit for responders.
quotes: Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS FOR PRIVATE EQUITY INVESTMENT CONSULTANT SERVICES
The System is seeking a private equity investment consulting firm to advise the System on an ongoing basis in matters involving the management of the private equity portfolio.
The firm and/or its principals have experience providing private equity consulting services to clients, in aggregate, with private equity portfolio assets of at least $10 billion.
